name: Fuji Yukari
source:
Best friend of Nozomi.

Yukari is an alluring, mature housewive, who currently lives alone in her house, while her husband and son are staying abroad.
Like Nozomi she used to be a member of a biker gang.

In Motoyan Oku-san to Gyaru Musume-chan she is the Junior of Nao during there school days.
